entities.name: PMID:27506904
observations: In isogenic C2/C2VHL and 786-O/786-OVHL ccRCC cells, HDAC1 overexpression increased invasion and was associated with increased matrix metalloproteinase expression.
In the same study, HDAC6 overexpression increased cell motility/migration, linked to reduced acetylated alpha-tubulin; HDAC6 inhibition attenuated the motility effect.

entities.name: PMID:32113161
observations: In ccRCC models, CBX4 promoted migration/metastasis; disrupting the CBX4-HDAC1 interaction or restoring KLF6 attenuated CBX4-mediated migration. This supports an indirect pro-migratory CBX4-HDAC1 pathway, not a clean HDAC1-only perturbation study.

entities.name: PMID:39063958
observations: Selective HDAC6 inhibitors and genetic HDAC6 knockdown were tested in RCC cells, but reported outcomes were viability, DNA replication, and apoptosis rather than migration, invasion, EMT, or metastasis.

entities.name: HDAC1
observations: Direct evidence in ccRCC supports a pro-invasive effect when HDAC1 is overexpressed; an indirect CBX4-HDAC1 mechanism also supports pro-migratory behavior.

entities.name: HDAC6
observations: Direct evidence in ccRCC supports a pro-migratory/pro-motility effect of HDAC6 overexpression, attenuated by HDAC6 inhibition; other RCC HDAC6 studies without migration/invasion endpoints do not alter this conclusion.
